capabilities: Embed local or remote code files in notes using ![[file.ext]] syntax
Extract symbols, line ranges, or HTML elements from embedded files
Highlight specific lines and show real source-file line numbers
Upload clipboard code to the vault, WebDAV, or GitHub Gist and insert an embed link
Configure remote source aliases for GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, WebDAV, and generic URLs
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Chinese-language documentation is linked at the top of the README. SSL certificate skip verification is desktop-only and disabled by default. Supports 40+ programming languages with a configurable file extension table.
problem: Obsidian's native embeds cannot render code files as highlighted code, extract specific functions or line ranges, or pull files from remote repositories into notes.
